blurb: Guests can enjoy a fully customizable day on the water with an experienced captain, choosing from various boats including the Octolounge and the Kraken. Options include bar hopping, swimming at sandbars, and themed cruises like morning mimosa, history & wildlife, sunset, and dinner cruises. The Floatilla combines both boats for groups up to 26 guests.
